selection_policy.objective: Highest average net R after a hypothetical 0.02R round-trip cost

assumptions.entry: M5 signal-bar close; stop checks begin on following M1 bar.
assumptions.position_management: One open position for this setup.
assumptions.session_gap: Exit at prior M1 close if the next M1 timestamp gaps.
assumptions.cost_scenarios: 0 to 0.10R per round trip; sensitivity only, not a broker quote.
assumptions.test_period: Diagnostic only; prior analysis has inspected this period.
